arguments.summary: Decision: develop differentiated, non-ranked 21/63-session research theses for ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, conditioned on company fundamentals, dated QQQ look-through, fixed benchmark technical context, macro/policy transmission and explicit missingness. Grouped assignments have been dispatched to Company, Macro, Technical and Geopolitics. Commodities is omitted because no direct commodity-price input or clearly material commodity transmission channel is established in the seeded catalog; MU supply-cycle exposure will instead be covered under company/policy research.

claims.text: The planning decision is limited to research drafts over 21 and 63 sessions for ANET, QQQ, MU, META and NVDA, with SPY and declared sector benchmarks as context rather than a ranking or calibrated forecast.

Company-specific operating evidence, ETF holdings, macro/policy channels and market-relative technical evidence are complementary inputs: none alone is sufficient for a differentiated short-horizon assessment.

gaps.description: No completed specialist evidence is yet available; company valuation assumptions, current policy/macro readings, earnings-event timing, and technical measures remain unverified pending the assigned work.
A commodity-specific dataset or demonstrated material commodity-price transmission channel is not present in the seeded source catalog.

assumptions: The fixed SPY, XLK and XLC context is used only as declared market/sector comparison, not as a proxy for portfolio breadth.
QQQ look-through will be dated to its seeded sponsor profile/holdings and will not assume current weights beyond that coverage date.
No ranking, actionable quote, or calibrated return forecast will be produced from the planned research.
arguments.counter_thesis: Short-horizon price behavior may be dominated by an unobserved earnings, policy, or macro event, so filed fundamentals and historical technical context may not resolve the 21/63-session decision.

review_conditions.description: Review the combined specialist record before assigning any instrument-level assessment, because material factual inputs are still pending.

shared_exposures.mechanism: Potential common sensitivity to growth expectations, discount rates, risk appetite and policy shocks is being tested by the Macro and Geopolitics assignments; QQQ overlap is to be verified from the dated holdings source.
shared_exposures.qualification: This is a research hypothesis, not a measured exposure or statement of holdings weights; the required source review is pending.
